simple.meaning: נֶחֱלָמִי (Nechĕlâmîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Nechelamite , or descendant of Nechlam.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נֶחֱלָמִי (H5161) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Jeremiah 29:24, with occurrences in Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נֶחֱלָמִי (H5161) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נֶחֱלָמִי (H5161) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נֶחֱלָמִי (Nechĕlâmîy) / H5161 is traced through Jeremiah 29:24, Jeremiah 29:31, Jeremiah 29:32 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a Nechelamite , or descendant of Nechlam
definitions.full: H5161. Nechelami נֶחֱלָמִי adjective, of a people (noun not found); — Jer 29:24 ; also 29:31 ; 29:32 (Where van d. H. נֶחְלָמִי ). נַחֲלָת see נַחֲלֶה .
definitions.rootNote: apparently a patronymic from an unused name (apparently passive participle of 2492 ); dreamed ;

occurrences.englishText: Concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite you shall speak, saying,
“Send to all of the captives, saying, ‘Yahweh says concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: “Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, and I didn’t send him, and he has caused you to trust in a lie;”

therefore Yahweh says, “Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his offspring. He will not have a man to dwell among this people. He won’t see the good that I will do to my people,” says Yahweh, “because he has spoken rebellion against Yahweh.” ’ ”
